name: Pattern 7: Temporal Region
description: Represents temporal regions in BFO terms, distinguishing a zero-dimensional temporal region (an instant such as the start or end of an event) from a one-dimensional temporal region (an interval with a duration), related by occupies_temporal_region, has_first_instance and has_last_instance. Data about those regions - start date, end date, duration, frequency - is carried by specification datum individuals linked to their values with nfdicore:hasValue.
